title: blsprice
summary: Compute Black-Scholes European call and put option prices.

gpu_support.broadcasting: scalar expansion over matching nonscalar inputs
gpu_support.notes: `blsprice` gathers gpuArray inputs and evaluates the host scalar/vectorized Black-Scholes formula. A provider-resident elementwise fast path is deferred to the queued runmat-accelerate GPU audit.

description: `blsprice(Price,Strike,Rate,Time,Volatility)` computes European call and put option prices using the Black-Scholes model. An optional `Yield` argument defaults to zero.
behaviors: Returns the call price as the single-output value and `[Call, Put]` under two-output semantics.
Each input may be scalar or a vector/matrix. Scalars expand across all options; nonscalar inputs must have matching dimensions.
The optional `Yield` argument represents a continuously compounded dividend or foreign risk-free yield; an empty `Yield` uses the default zero yield.
Invalid financial domains and `NaN` inputs produce elementwise `NaN` outputs rather than aborting the full call.
